seoTitle: Mobile, TV & Laptop Repair in Siliguri
seoDescription: Find mobile repair shops, LED TV, laptop and CCTV technicians in Siliguri. Compare ratings and distance, then call the shop directly. No booking fee.
seoHeading: Mobile, TV and laptop repair in Siliguri
imageAlt: Technician repairing a smartphone circuit board at a repair counter
seoContent:
Siliguri has more electronics repair counters than almost any town its size in North Bengal. Mobile repair shops line Hill Cart Road, Sevoke Road and the lanes around Bidhan Market and Hong Kong Market, while TV, laptop and CCTV technicians work out of smaller workshops across Pradhan Nagar, Hakimpara, Ashrampara, Matigara and Bagdogra. KaajVa lists them in one place, with the address, the brands they handle, opening hours and reviews from people who used them, so you can find one near you and call directly.

Most repairs start with a diagnosis. Phone shops usually check the fault on the spot; TV and laptop technicians may charge a small inspection fee, often adjusted against the bill if you go ahead. Screen, battery and charging-port jobs on phones are usually same-day. LED TV panel faults, motherboard work and data recovery take longer, and the part decides the price, so ask for the quote before the work starts and ask whether the part is original, OEM or compatible.

Siliguri's long monsoon is hard on electronics. Humidity gets into charging ports, speakers and TV boards, and voltage swings during storms damage power supplies. If a device has been wet, switch it off and take it in quickly rather than trying to charge it. A stabiliser or a good surge protector for the TV, set-top box and Wi-Fi router saves many repair bills between June and September.

For shops and homes adding security, CCTV installers on KaajVa supply and fit cameras, DVR or NVR recorders and phone viewing, and many service the setup afterwards. Compare two or three quotes, keep the bill, and ask how long the warranty on the repair lasts.

faqs.q: Where can I get my mobile repaired in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Mobile repair shops are spread across Siliguri, with many around Hill Cart Road, Sevoke Road, Bidhan Market and Hong Kong Market. Search Mobile Phone Repair on KaajVa to see shops near you with their hours and reviews, then call to check they have the part for your model.

faqs.q: How much does mobile screen replacement cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the phone and the type of screen. A compatible screen for a budget phone costs much less than an original screen for a flagship. Ask the shop for both prices, and ask whether the price includes fitting and a warranty.

faqs.q: Do TV repair technicians in Siliguri come home?
faqs.a: Most TV technicians visit your home to diagnose the fault and fix small problems. Panel or board repairs are often done at their workshop; ask about pickup and drop and how many days the repair will take.

faqs.q: Will a local repair void my phone or laptop warranty?
faqs.a: If the device is still under the manufacturer's warranty, go to the authorised service centre first. Once the warranty has ended, a good local technician is usually faster and cheaper.

faqs.q: My phone fell in water. What should I do?
faqs.a: Switch it off, do not charge it, and take it to a repair shop as soon as you can. Rice does not dry the inside of a phone; a technician opens it and cleans the board before corrosion sets in.

faqs.q: Can I get CCTV cameras installed in my shop or home in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. CCTV installers on KaajVa supply and fit cameras, recorders and mobile viewing for homes, shops and godowns. Tell them how many entrances you want covered and how many days of recording you need, and compare quotes.

seoTitle: AC, Fridge & Washing Machine Repair Siliguri
seoDescription: AC service and repair, fridge, washing machine, RO purifier, geyser and chimney repair in Siliguri. Compare local technicians and call directly.
seoHeading: AC and home appliance repair in Siliguri
imageAlt: Split air conditioner indoor unit installed on a wall
seoContent:
Siliguri summers are hot and sticky, and the monsoon that follows is one of the wettest in West Bengal, so air conditioners, fridges and water purifiers work hard here. KaajVa lists appliance technicians across Siliguri, from Sevoke Road, Pradhan Nagar and Hakimpara to Matigara, Champasari, Bagdogra and Shivmandir, for AC service and gas refilling, refrigerator repair, washing machine repair, RO purifier service, geyser repair, microwave repair and kitchen chimney cleaning.

AC service demand peaks from March to June, and good technicians get booked out in the first hot week, so service your AC before the heat arrives. A standard split AC service (filter, coil and drain cleaning) is a fixed-price job; gas top-ups, PCB repairs and compressor work are quoted after a check. Ask whether gas is charged by weight or by pressure check, and get the warranty on the repair in writing.

Many homes in Siliguri use borewell or tank water with iron and sediment, which clogs RO filters and leaves scale in geysers and washing machines. Changing the sediment and carbon filters on time and descaling the geyser once a year keeps them working longer. In the monsoon, keep the fridge and washing machine on a stand away from damp floors and use a stabiliser, since storms bring voltage swings.

Call two or three technicians near you, tell them the brand, model and what is wrong, and compare the visiting charge and quote. You deal with the technician directly; KaajVa adds no booking fee.

faqs.q: When should I service my AC in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Before the summer, ideally in February or March, before technicians get busy. If you run the AC daily, a second service after the monsoon helps, because humidity and dust clog the coils and drain.

faqs.q: How much does AC service cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: A standard split AC service is usually a fixed charge of a few hundred rupees to around a thousand, depending on the technician and how deep the cleaning is. Gas refilling and repairs cost more and are quoted after a check. Compare two or three quotes.

faqs.q: My fridge is not cooling. Is it worth repairing?
faqs.a: Usually yes. Thermostats, relays, fans and gas leaks are common faults that cost far less than a new fridge. If the compressor has failed on a fridge more than ten years old, compare the quote with a new one.

faqs.q: How often should an RO purifier be serviced in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Every three to six months. Because many sources here carry iron and sediment, the pre-filter and sediment filter often need changing sooner than the brand suggests. The membrane usually lasts one to two years.

faqs.q: Do technicians repair all brands?
faqs.a: Most local technicians repair the common brands such as LG, Samsung, Voltas, Whirlpool, Godrej and Daikin. Each listing on KaajVa shows the brands they service; for an unusual brand, ask on the call whether they can get parts.

faqs.q: Is the visiting charge adjusted if I go ahead with the repair?
faqs.a: Many technicians adjust it against the repair bill, but not all. Ask on the call so there are no surprises.

seoTitle: Electrician in Siliguri: Wiring, Fans & Inverters
seoDescription: Find a verified electrician near you in Siliguri for house wiring, fan and light fitting, inverter installation and MCB repair. Compare and call directly.
seoHeading: Electricians near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: Electrician installing and testing wiring in a building
seoContent:
From a ceiling fan that will not start to full house rewiring, KaajVa lists electricians (electric mistris) across Siliguri, including Pradhan Nagar, Hakimpara, Ashrampara, Sevoke Road, Matigara, Champasari, Salugara and Bagdogra. Each listing shows the work they take on, opening hours, whether they come out at night and reviews from customers, so you can pick someone close by and call.

Small jobs such as changing a switch or socket, fitting a fan or a tube light, or replacing an MCB are usually charged per job, with a visiting charge for the first visit. New points, concealed wiring and rewiring are quoted after an inspection. Ask whether wire, switches and MCBs are included in the quote, which brand of wire will be used, and whether the electrician will check the earthing.

Siliguri gets frequent storms from April to September, and lightning and voltage swings are common. An electrician can fit an RCCB to protect against shocks, a surge protector for the main board, and proper earthing for your AC, fridge and water pump. Many homes here also depend on an inverter during power cuts; electricians who list inverter work can size the inverter and battery for the fans and lights you want to run and wire a separate inverter line.

Older houses in the city centre often have wiring that was never meant for today's ACs, geysers and induction cooktops. If MCBs trip often, switches feel warm, or you smell burning, switch off the main and call an electrician straight away instead of doing it yourself.

faqs.q: How do I find a good electrician near me in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Electricians on KaajVa, sort by distance or rating, and read recent reviews. Describe the job on the call and ask for the visiting charge and an estimate before the work starts.

faqs.q: How much does an electrician charge for small jobs in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Small jobs like changing a switch or fitting a fan usually cost a few hundred rupees plus parts. Wiring and new points are quoted after the electrician sees the site.

faqs.q: Can an electrician install an inverter and battery?
faqs.a: Yes. Electricians who list inverter work can recommend the right capacity, install the inverter and battery, and wire the lights and fans you want on backup.

faqs.q: Why does my MCB keep tripping?
faqs.a: Usually an overloaded circuit, a fault in an appliance, or moisture in a switchboard, which is common in the monsoon. Unplug heavy appliances and call an electrician to find the fault rather than forcing the MCB back on.

faqs.q: When should I rewire my house?
faqs.a: If the wiring is more than 20 to 25 years old, sockets feel warm, the MCB trips often, or you are adding ACs and geysers, ask an electrician to inspect it and advise.

faqs.q: Are electricians available at night or on holidays in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Some are; their listing shows their hours, and you can use the Open now filter. Night and holiday visits usually cost more.

seoTitle: Plumber in Siliguri: Leaks, Taps, Tanks & Motors
seoDescription: Find a plumber near you in Siliguri for leaking taps, bathroom fitting, blocked drains, water tank cleaning and pump motor repair. Call local plumbers directly.
seoHeading: Plumbers near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: Plumber fixing the pipes under a kitchen sink
seoContent:
A dripping tap, a blocked drain or a pump that will not lift water to the overhead tank needs a plumber nearby, quickly. KaajVa lists plumbers (plumber mistris) across Siliguri, in Pradhan Nagar, Hakimpara, Shivmandir, Matigara, Champasari, Bagdogra and beyond, for leak repair, tap and fitting replacement, bathroom and kitchen fitting, drain unblocking, water tank cleaning and motor and pump repair.

Most Siliguri homes run on a borewell or municipal line feeding an underground sump and an overhead tank, pushed up by a pump motor. That means many plumbing calls here are about the motor, the float switch or the tank rather than the taps. Plumbers who list Motor & Pump Repair can fix or replace the motor, set up an automatic level controller, and check why the pump is running dry.

The monsoon is the busiest time. Heavy rain overloads drains, roof outlets block with leaves, and damp patches show up where a concealed pipe has been leaking for months. Clearing roof and balcony outlets before June and cleaning tanks after the rains saves most emergency calls. Iron and sediment in local water also stain tanks and clog aerators and flush valves, so a tank cleaning every three to six months is worth it.

Most plumbers charge a visiting fee plus a per-job price. Ask for labour and materials to be listed separately so you can compare quotes fairly, and send a photo of the problem on WhatsApp so the plumber brings the right parts.

faqs.q: How do I find a plumber near me in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Plumbing on KaajVa and sort by distance or rating. For an urgent leak, use the Open now filter and call two plumbers to compare visiting charges.

faqs.q: How much does a plumber charge to fix a leaking tap?
faqs.a: Fixing a washer or cartridge is usually a small per-job charge plus the part. Replacing the tap or opening a wall for a concealed leak costs more; ask for an estimate first.

faqs.q: How often should I clean my water tank in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Every three to six months, and once after the monsoon. Iron and sediment in local water settle quickly, so tanks here need cleaning more often than in many cities.

faqs.q: Can a plumber repair my water pump motor?
faqs.a: Yes. Plumbers who list Motor & Pump Repair service and repair domestic motors, pressure pumps and float switches, and can fit an automatic water level controller.

faqs.q: What should I do while waiting for the plumber?
faqs.a: Close the main valve or the valve under the sink, switch off the pump motor, and move anything valuable away from the water.

faqs.q: Why do damp patches appear on my wall in the monsoon?
faqs.a: Often a slow leak from a concealed pipe or a bathroom above, or rain seeping through cracks. A plumber can test the pipes; if they are fine, the cause is usually waterproofing.

seoTitle: Carpenter in Siliguri: Furniture & Kitchens
seoDescription: Find a carpenter in Siliguri for furniture repair, modular kitchens, wardrobes, doors and windows. Compare local carpenters, see their work and call directly.
seoHeading: Carpenters near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: Carpenter sanding a wooden board in a workshop
seoContent:
Whether it is a door that will not close in the monsoon, a new wardrobe or a full modular kitchen, KaajVa lists carpenters (kath mistris) and furniture workshops across Siliguri, including Pradhan Nagar, Hakimpara, Babupara, Matigara, Champasari and Bagdogra. Listings show the work they do, photos of past jobs where they have added them, and reviews, so you can compare before you call.

Siliguri's humidity is the biggest enemy of woodwork. Doors and windows swell and stick between June and September, drawers jam, and particle board that was never sealed at the edges starts to bubble near sinks. For kitchens and bathrooms, ask your carpenter about BWP (boiling water proof) plywood or marine ply instead of MR grade, and make sure every cut edge is edge-banded. Termites are also common in North Bengal, so ask whether the wood or board is treated.

Small repairs such as fixing hinges, locks, channels or a broken chair are usually charged per job. Wardrobes, beds, TV units and modular kitchens are priced by the running foot or square foot, and the material decides most of the cost: plywood grade, laminate or veneer, and the brand of hinges and channels. Ask for the material list in writing so you can compare quotes on the same specification.

Good carpenters are busy before Durga Puja, Diwali and the winter wedding season, so book early if you want furniture ready for a festival or a house move.

faqs.q: How do I find a good carpenter in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Carpentry on KaajVa, look at photos of past work and recent reviews, and ask the carpenter to visit and measure before quoting.

faqs.q: How are wardrobes and modular kitchens priced?
faqs.a: Usually per square foot or running foot. The plywood grade, laminate, and hinge and channel brand decide most of the cost, so compare quotes on the same materials.

faqs.q: Which plywood is best for kitchens in Siliguri's humidity?
faqs.a: BWP (boiling water proof) or marine plywood for anything near water, with all edges sealed. MR grade is fine for bedroom wardrobes away from damp walls.

faqs.q: Why do my doors swell and stick in the monsoon?
faqs.a: Wood absorbs moisture in humid weather. A carpenter can plane the edge and seal it; painting or polishing all sides of the door, including the top and bottom, stops it happening again.

faqs.q: Can carpenters repair old furniture?
faqs.a: Yes. Most carpenters fix joints, legs, hinges, drawer channels and broken frames, and many also re-polish furniture.

seoTitle: Home Deep Cleaning Services in Siliguri
seoDescription: Home deep cleaning, sofa and carpet cleaning, bathroom and kitchen cleaning in Siliguri. Compare local cleaning services, check reviews and call directly.
seoHeading: Home and office cleaning services in Siliguri
imageAlt: Cleaner vacuuming a bright living room during a home deep clean
seoContent:
A full deep clean is the quickest way to get a home ready for a festival, a new tenant or a family visit. KaajVa lists cleaning services in Siliguri for full home deep cleaning, kitchen and bathroom cleaning, sofa, mattress and carpet shampooing, and office and shop cleaning, with their reviews, hours and the areas they cover.

Demand peaks in the weeks before Durga Puja, Kali Puja and Diwali, when many families clean the whole house, so book a week or two ahead in September and October. Move-in and move-out cleaning is busy around March and April, when transfers and school admissions bring people to and from Siliguri.

The monsoon leaves its own work here: mould on bathroom grout and ceilings, a musty smell in cupboards, and fine dust from the dry winter months settling on fans and windows. Good cleaners use mould treatment for bathrooms, machine scrubbing for floors and tiles, and wet extraction for sofas and mattresses so the fabric dries properly in the humid air. Ask how long the sofa will take to dry before you book in the rainy season.

Cleaning is usually priced by the size of the home (1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK) or by the item for sofas and carpets. Ask what is included (inside cupboards, balconies, windows, fans), how many people will come and how long it will take, and whether they bring their own equipment and chemicals.

faqs.q: How much does home deep cleaning cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It is usually priced by home size, such as 1, 2 or 3 BHK, plus extras like sofa or mattress cleaning. Ask each service what is included so you compare like for like.

faqs.q: How long does a full home deep clean take?
faqs.a: A team of two to four people usually finishes a 2 BHK in a day. Larger homes or very dirty kitchens can take longer.

faqs.q: Can sofas be cleaned during the monsoon?
faqs.a: Yes, but they take longer to dry in Siliguri's humidity. Ask for wet extraction cleaning, keep the fans running, and avoid sitting on the sofa until it is fully dry.

faqs.q: Do cleaners bring their own equipment?
faqs.a: Most professional services bring vacuums, scrubbing machines and chemicals. Confirm on the call, especially for smaller teams.

faqs.q: When should I book cleaning before Durga Puja or Diwali?
faqs.a: One to two weeks ahead. Slots fill up fast in September and October.

seoTitle: Pest Control in Siliguri: Termites & Cockroaches
seoDescription: Termite, cockroach, bed bug, mosquito and rodent control in Siliguri. Compare local pest control services, check reviews and call directly.
seoHeading: Pest control services in Siliguri
imageAlt: Pest control technician spraying a treatment along a wall
seoContent:
Siliguri's warm, humid climate and its long monsoon suit termites, cockroaches and mosquitoes all too well. KaajVa lists pest control services across Siliguri for termite treatment, cockroach and ant gel treatment, bed bug treatment, mosquito control and rodent control, for flats, independent houses, shops, restaurants and godowns.

Termites are the most expensive problem here. Look for mud tubes on walls, hollow-sounding door frames and small piles of wood dust near furniture. For an existing house, the usual treatment is drilling along the walls and injecting a termiticide (post-construction treatment); for a new building, an anti-termite treatment of the soil before the floor is laid lasts much longer. Ask which chemical is used, how many years the warranty lasts and whether follow-up visits are free.

Cockroach and ant problems are usually handled with gel baits, which are odourless and safe to use in a lived-in kitchen. Bed bugs need two visits about two weeks apart. Mosquito fogging and larvicide help most in the monsoon and after it, when dengue cases in North Bengal tend to rise; clearing standing water in coolers, flower pots and roof gutters matters just as much.

Ask the service whether the chemicals are approved for home use, how long you need to stay out, and how to protect children, pets and food. A good service explains the treatment before starting and leaves you a written warranty.

faqs.q: How much does termite treatment cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It is usually priced by the area of the home in square feet, and depends on whether it is a pre-construction or post-construction treatment. Ask for the chemical, the warranty period and free follow-up visits in writing.

faqs.q: When is the best time for pest control in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Just before and after the monsoon. Termites and cockroaches become active in the humid months, and mosquito control matters most from June to October.

faqs.q: Is cockroach gel treatment safe with children at home?
faqs.a: Gel baits are placed in cracks and hinges out of reach and have no smell, which is why they are preferred in homes. Ask the technician where they will place it.

faqs.q: How many visits does bed bug treatment need?
faqs.a: Usually two, about two weeks apart, to catch the bugs that hatch from eggs after the first treatment.

faqs.q: How do I know if I have termites?
faqs.a: Mud tubes on walls, hollow-sounding wood, papery or damaged door frames, and small heaps of wood dust or winged insects after rain are the usual signs.

seoTitle: House Painters in Siliguri: Interior & Exterior
seoDescription: Find house painters and painting contractors in Siliguri for interior, exterior, texture and waterproofing work. Compare quotes and call directly.
seoHeading: House painters near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: House painter rolling fresh paint onto a wall
seoContent:
KaajVa lists house painters and painting contractors across Siliguri for interior and exterior painting, texture and designer finishes, wood polish, and waterproofing of roofs and walls. Each listing shows the kind of work they take on, photos where they have added them, and reviews, so you can call two or three and compare.

Timing matters in Siliguri. The best months to paint are October to March, when the air is dry and paint cures properly. Exterior paint applied in the monsoon often peels or blooms with fungus within a year. The busiest weeks are just before Durga Puja, Kali Puja and Diwali, so book a painter in August or early September if you want the house ready for the festivals.

Humidity and heavy rain are the main reasons walls fail here. Before repainting, a good painter checks for damp patches, scrapes off loose putty, treats fungus, and fixes the cause of seepage, whether it is a roof crack, a leaking pipe or rising damp. For exterior walls and roofs, ask about a waterproof or elastomeric coating rather than ordinary emulsion.

Painting is usually quoted per square foot of wall area, separately for labour and material, or as a total contract. The quote should say the brand and range of paint, the number of putty and primer coats, how many coats of paint, and who moves and covers the furniture. Compare quotes on the same specification, not just the final number.

faqs.q: How much does house painting cost per square foot in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the paint range, the number of putty and primer coats and whether material is included. Ask painters to quote labour and material separately per square foot so you can compare fairly.

faqs.q: When is the best time to paint a house in Siliguri?
faqs.a: October to March, when the weather is dry. Avoid exterior painting in the monsoon; paint does not cure properly in heavy humidity.

faqs.q: How long does it take to paint a 2 BHK?
faqs.a: Usually five to eight working days for the interior with putty and two coats, depending on wall condition and team size.

faqs.q: Can painters fix damp and seepage before painting?
faqs.a: Many painting contractors also do waterproofing. Ask them to find and fix the cause of the damp first; painting over it only hides it for a few months.

faqs.q: Do painters move and cover the furniture?
faqs.a: Most cover floors and furniture with sheets and move light items. Agree on it before the work starts and keep valuables aside.

seoTitle: Packers and Movers in Siliguri
seoDescription: Local packers and movers in Siliguri for house shifting, office moves, bike and car transport, and moves to Kolkata, Guwahati and beyond. Compare and call.
seoHeading: Packers and movers in Siliguri
imageAlt: Packing boxes taped and labelled for a house move
seoContent:
Siliguri sits where North Bengal, Sikkim, Bhutan, Nepal and the North East meet, so moving companies here handle a mix of local shifting, long-distance moves to Kolkata, Guwahati, Delhi and Bengaluru, and moves up to Darjeeling, Kalimpong and Gangtok. KaajVa lists packers and movers in Siliguri for house shifting, office relocation, bike and car transport, and loading and unloading, with reviews and contact details.

For a move within Siliguri, from say Pradhan Nagar to Matigara or Champasari, most movers quote by the size of the home and the floor, including packing, a truck, loading and unloading. Long-distance moves are priced by the volume or weight of goods and the distance, and part-load options are cheaper when you are not in a hurry. Moves to the hills cost more because they need smaller vehicles and careful driving on mountain roads.

Ask every mover for a written quote after they have seen the goods, either in person or on a video call. The quote should say what packing material is used, whether dismantling and fixing furniture is included, the GST, and whether goods are covered by transit insurance. Never pay the full amount upfront, and make sure the lorry receipt (bilty) has the company's name, address and GST number.

Plan for the season. March to May, when transfers and school terms change, is the busiest time. In the monsoon, ask for waterproof wrapping and a covered truck, especially for long routes through the Dooars and Assam.

faqs.q: How much do packers and movers charge in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Local moves are usually priced by home size, floor and distance; long-distance moves by the volume of goods and the route. Get at least two written quotes after a survey so you can compare.

faqs.q: Can I shift my bike or car from Siliguri to another city?
faqs.a: Yes. Many movers transport two-wheelers and cars in closed carriers or with household goods. Keep the RC, insurance and ID ready, and note any existing scratches before handover.

faqs.q: Do movers in Siliguri handle moves to Darjeeling, Sikkim or Gangtok?
faqs.a: Several do. Hill moves need smaller vehicles and take longer, so they cost more than the same distance on the plains.

faqs.q: How do I avoid a fake packers and movers company?
faqs.a: Check reviews, visit or video-call the office, insist on a written quote and a lorry receipt with a GST number, and never pay the full amount in advance.

faqs.q: Is transit insurance worth it?
faqs.a: For long-distance moves, yes. It is a small percentage of the declared value and covers damage or loss on the road. Ask what is covered and how claims work.

faqs.q: When is the busiest time for shifting in Siliguri?
faqs.a: March to May. Book two to three weeks ahead in that period.

seoTitle: Home Tutors in Siliguri: All Classes & Boards
seoDescription: Find home tutors and coaching in Siliguri for CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE, Class 1 to 12, JEE, NEET and college subjects. Compare tutors and call directly.
seoHeading: Home tutors and tuition in Siliguri
imageAlt: Home tutor helping a student with homework at a table
seoContent:
Siliguri has a large and growing student population, with CBSE, ICSE and West Bengal Board schools across the city, colleges such as Siliguri College, and North Bengal University on its edge. KaajVa lists home tutors and tuition centres across Siliguri, including Pradhan Nagar, Hakimpara, Ashrampara, Deshbandhu Para, Subhash Pally, Champasari, Matigara and Bagdogra, for primary classes, Class 9 to 12 board exams, JEE and NEET preparation, spoken English, and college subjects.

Start with what the student needs. For Class 1 to 8, a single tutor for all subjects who checks homework and builds habits usually works best. From Class 9, most families move to subject tutors for Maths, Science and English, chosen for the board the child is in, because CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE syllabuses and exam patterns differ. For JEE, NEET and other entrance exams, a tutor or small batch that gives regular tests matters more than the hours.

Fees in Siliguri depend on the class, the subject, the tutor's experience and whether the tutor comes home or teaches a batch. Home tuition costs more than a group class. Ask how many days a week, how long each class is, and whether the tutor gives tests and reports progress. A trial class or two before you commit is common and worth asking for.

Many tutors here teach in English, Bengali, Hindi and Nepali, so mention which language the student is most comfortable in. For younger children, ask whether a parent can sit in for the first few classes.

faqs.q: How do I find a good home tutor in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Tutors on KaajVa, filter by subject and area, and read reviews from other parents. Ask for a trial class, and check the tutor knows your child's board.

faqs.q: How much does home tuition cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the class, the subjects and whether the tutor comes home or teaches a batch. Higher classes and entrance preparation cost more. Ask tutors for a monthly fee and the number of classes included.

faqs.q: Are there tutors for CBSE, ICSE and West Bengal Board in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Many tutors specialise in one board. Mention your child's board and class on the call.

faqs.q: Can I find JEE or NEET coaching in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Several tutors and small coaching centres prepare students for JEE, NEET and other entrance exams. Ask about test series, batch size and past results.

faqs.q: Do tutors in Siliguri teach in Bengali, Hindi or Nepali?
faqs.a: Many do. Say which language the student is most comfortable in when you call.

faqs.q: Is a trial class normal?
faqs.a: Yes. Most tutors offer one or two trial classes so the student and tutor can see if it works before agreeing to monthly fees.

seoTitle: Beauty Parlour, Salon & Bridal Makeup Siliguri
seoDescription: Find beauty parlours, salons, makeup artists and salon at home services in Siliguri. Compare reviews and services, then call or WhatsApp directly.
seoHeading: Beauty parlours and salons in Siliguri
imageAlt: Hair stylist styling a customer's hair in a salon
seoContent:
KaajVa lists beauty parlours, unisex salons, men's salons, makeup artists and salon at home services across Siliguri, from Sevoke Road, Hill Cart Road and Pradhan Nagar to Hakimpara, Ashrampara, Champasari, Matigara and Bagdogra. Listings show services, hours and reviews, so you can find a parlour close to home or a makeup artist for a wedding and call or WhatsApp directly.

Everyday services such as haircuts, threading, waxing, facials, hair spa, manicures and pedicures are offered by most parlours, at prices that vary with the brand of products used. Unisex salons and men's salons add beard grooming and hair colour. If you prefer not to travel, salon at home professionals bring their kit and do most of these services at your place; ask about hygiene, disposable items and travel charges.

Bridal and party makeup is busiest from November to February, the main wedding season in North Bengal, and again around Durga Puja. Good makeup artists are booked months ahead, so contact them early, look at their past work, and book a trial. Ask whether the price covers HD or airbrush makeup, hairstyling, draping, false lashes and travel to the venue, and how long they will stay for touch-ups.

Siliguri's humidity makes long-wear makeup and frizz control more important than in drier cities. Ask your artist about waterproof and sweat-proof products for summer and monsoon functions, and about hair treatments for frizz.

faqs.q: How do I find a good beauty parlour near me in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Beauty & Salon on KaajVa, sort by distance or rating, and read recent reviews. Check the services and hours on the listing before you go.

faqs.q: How much does bridal makeup cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It varies with the artist's experience and the type of makeup (HD, airbrush), and whether hairstyling, draping and travel are included. Ask for the full package price and book a trial.

faqs.q: When should I book a bridal makeup artist?
faqs.a: Two to four months ahead for the November to February wedding season. Popular artists are fully booked on auspicious dates.

faqs.q: Is salon at home available in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Salon at home professionals on KaajVa offer facials, waxing, threading, manicure, pedicure and party makeup at your place. Ask about travel charges and hygiene.

faqs.q: Are there men's salons and unisex salons in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Many listings are unisex or men's salons offering haircuts, beard styling, hair colour and facials.

seoTitle: Bike and Car Service in Siliguri
seoDescription: Find bike and car service centres and mechanics in Siliguri for servicing, repairs, denting, painting, tyres and batteries. Compare and call directly.
seoHeading: Bike and car service in Siliguri
imageAlt: Mechanic repairing a car engine in a garage
seoContent:
Siliguri's roads see heavy daily use: city traffic on Sevoke Road and Hill Cart Road, highway runs on NH 10 and NH 27, and frequent trips up to Darjeeling, Mirik, Kalimpong, Gangtok and the Dooars. KaajVa lists bike and car mechanics, multi-brand workshops, two-wheeler service centres, denting and painting shops, tyre and battery dealers and car wash centres across Siliguri, Matigara, Bagdogra, Champasari and Siliguri's highway stretches.

A regular service covers the engine oil, oil and air filters, brake check, chain or belt, coolant and a general inspection. Two-wheelers usually need a service every 2,500 to 3,000 km, and cars every 10,000 km or once a year, whichever comes first, but check your owner's manual. A multi-brand workshop is usually cheaper than the authorised dealer for labour; ask whether they use genuine or OEM parts and give you the old parts back.

Hill driving is hard on brakes and clutches. If you drive to the hills often, get the brake pads, clutch and coolant checked more often, and listen for brake squeal or a burning smell on the way down. In the monsoon, waterlogged roads around the city cause electrical faults, rust and brake problems, so get wiring, brakes and wipers checked before June, and avoid starting a car that has been sitting in deep water.

Ask the mechanic for an estimate before work starts and for a call before any extra work. A good workshop explains what needs doing now and what can wait.

faqs.q: How often should I service my bike in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Every 2,500 to 3,000 km or every three to four months for most two-wheelers, more often if you ride daily in traffic or on hill roads. Follow your owner's manual.

faqs.q: Is a local garage as good as the authorised service centre?
faqs.a: For out-of-warranty vehicles, a good multi-brand workshop is often cheaper and quicker. Ask whether they use genuine or OEM parts. During the warranty period, use the authorised centre for scheduled services.

faqs.q: What should I check before driving to Darjeeling or Sikkim?
faqs.a: Brakes, clutch, tyres and their pressure, coolant and engine oil. A mechanic can do a quick pre-trip check the day before.

faqs.q: My car was in a waterlogged street. What should I do?
faqs.a: Do not start it if water reached the engine air intake. Call a mechanic or tow it to a workshop to check the engine, wiring and brakes first.

faqs.q: Do mechanics in Siliguri offer pickup and drop?
faqs.a: Some workshops do, especially for cars. It is shown on the listing or you can ask on the call.

faqs.q: Where can I get denting and painting done in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Vehicle Repair on KaajVa and look for denting and painting workshops. Ask whether they use paint matching and how many days the job takes.

seoTitle: Locksmith in Siliguri: Lock Repair & Keys
seoDescription: Find a locksmith in Siliguri for lockouts, lock repair, new locks, duplicate keys and digital door locks. Compare local locksmiths and call directly.
seoHeading: Locksmiths near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: Locksmith fitting a new lock on a wooden door
seoContent:
Locked out, lost a key, or want a stronger lock on the main door? KaajVa lists locksmiths and key makers in Siliguri for emergency door opening, lock repair and replacement, duplicate keys, almirah and godrej locks, shutter locks for shops, and digital and smart door locks.

Duplicate keys are the most common job. Key makers usually cut ordinary keys while you wait; computer-coded, dimple and vehicle keys need special blanks and machines, so call ahead to check. For a lockout, a locksmith can usually open the door without damage, but expect to show proof that you live there. Night and holiday call-outs cost more.

Siliguri's humidity rusts locks and padlocks quickly, especially on shutters and gates exposed to rain. A few drops of lock lubricant (not cooking oil) before and after the monsoon keeps them turning smoothly. If a key has become hard to turn, get the lock serviced before the key breaks inside.

For better security, ask about locks with a high number of levers or a cylinder rated against picking, a door chain or viewer, and a separate deadbolt for the main door. Digital locks with a PIN, fingerprint or card are popular in new flats; ask about battery backup and an emergency key before you buy.

faqs.q: I am locked out of my house in Siliguri. What should I do?
faqs.a: Call a locksmith listed on KaajVa who is open now. Describe the lock type, and keep an ID or address proof ready; locksmiths are right to check before opening a door.

faqs.q: How much does a locksmith charge to open a door?
faqs.a: It depends on the lock and the time of day. Night and holiday call-outs cost more. Ask for the price on the call before the locksmith comes.

faqs.q: Can I get a duplicate key made without the original lock?
faqs.a: For ordinary keys, the key itself is enough. For coded, dimple or vehicle keys, the key maker may need the code card or the vehicle documents.

faqs.q: Can a locksmith install a digital door lock?
faqs.a: Yes. Many locksmiths fit PIN, fingerprint and smart locks. Check the door thickness and ask about battery backup and an emergency key.

faqs.q: How do I stop locks rusting in the monsoon?
faqs.a: Use a graphite or lock lubricant spray before and after the rains, and cover outdoor padlocks. Avoid cooking oil, which collects dust.

seoTitle: Tailors in Siliguri: Blouse, Suit & Alterations
seoDescription: Find tailors in Siliguri for blouse stitching, salwar suits, men's shirts and trousers, school uniforms and alterations. Compare local tailors and call.
seoHeading: Tailors near you in Siliguri
imageAlt: Tailor measuring and stitching fabric at a sewing machine
seoContent:
KaajVa lists tailors and boutiques across Siliguri, including Hakimpara, Pradhan Nagar, Sevoke Road, Bidhan Market, Khalpara, Champasari and Matigara, for ladies' tailoring (blouses, salwar kameez, kurtis, lehengas and fall-pico), gents' tailoring (shirts, trousers, kurta-pyjama, suits and blazers), school uniforms, and alterations.

Blouse stitching is the most common request, and the price depends on the design: a plain blouse costs much less than one with lining, padding, princess cut or a designer back. Bring a blouse that fits you well as a sample, or ask the tailor to take fresh measurements. For lehengas and designer outfits, ask for a trial fitting before the final finish.

Plan around the busy seasons. Before Durga Puja and the November to February wedding season, good tailors take orders weeks in advance and stop accepting new ones close to the date. Give yourself at least two to three weeks for festive and wedding outfits, and longer for bridal wear. School uniform orders rush in from January to March, before the new session.

Ask the tailor about the delivery date, how many fittings are included, whether alterations after delivery are free, and how they handle fabric that shrinks. Siliguri's humid weather can make cotton shrink after the first wash, so pre-washing cotton fabric before stitching is a good idea.

faqs.q: How much does blouse stitching cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: A simple blouse costs less; lining, padding, princess cut or designer backs add to the price. Ask the tailor for prices by design.

faqs.q: How long does a tailor take to stitch a dress?
faqs.a: Usually a few days to a week for regular orders. Before Durga Puja and in the wedding season, allow two to three weeks or more.

faqs.q: Do tailors in Siliguri do alterations?
faqs.a: Yes. Most tailors take alterations such as fitting, length, hemming, zip and button replacement, often while you wait for small jobs.

faqs.q: Can I get school uniforms stitched in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Several tailors stitch uniforms for local schools. Order early in the year, before the new session rush.

faqs.q: Should I wash cotton fabric before stitching?
faqs.a: It helps. Cotton can shrink after the first wash, so pre-washing avoids a garment that becomes tight later.

seoTitle: Drivers in Siliguri: Daily, Outstation & Hills
seoDescription: Hire a driver in Siliguri for daily office runs, outstation trips, airport pickups from Bagdogra and hill drives to Darjeeling, Sikkim and the Dooars.
seoHeading: Drivers for hire in Siliguri
imageAlt: Driver at the wheel of a car on a road
seoContent:
Many families and businesses in Siliguri own a car but need someone to drive it, whether for the daily office or school run, a weekend in the Dooars, a drive up to Darjeeling or Gangtok, or a late arrival at Bagdogra Airport or NJP station. KaajVa lists drivers in Siliguri who can be hired by the day, the trip or the month, with their experience and the vehicles they can drive.

Driving in the hills is a different skill from city driving. Roads to Darjeeling, Mirik, Kalimpong and Sikkim are narrow, steep and often wet or foggy, with landslides during the monsoon. For hill trips, ask the driver how often they drive those routes, whether they know the alternative roads when one is closed, and whether they are comfortable with your car (manual or automatic, petrol or diesel).

Drivers usually charge by the day for local use, with a fixed number of hours, and add a night allowance for outstation trips when they stay overnight. Fuel, tolls, parking and the driver's food and stay on outstation trips are usually paid by the owner; agree on these before the trip. For a permanent driver, agree on the monthly salary, working hours, weekly off and overtime in writing.

Always check the driver's licence (and that it covers your type of vehicle), ask for an ID, and keep a copy. Ask for references from previous employers, and make sure your car insurance covers a hired driver.

faqs.q: How do I hire a driver in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Drivers on KaajVa, read reviews, and call to check their experience, availability and charges. Ask to see their driving licence and ID before the first trip.

faqs.q: How much does a driver charge per day in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the hours and whether the trip is local or outstation. Outstation trips usually include a night allowance, with fuel, tolls and the driver's food and stay paid separately. Agree on everything before the trip.

faqs.q: Can I hire a driver for a trip to Darjeeling or Sikkim?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask for a driver with regular hill experience on those routes, and check the weather and road status before leaving, especially in the monsoon.

faqs.q: Can a driver pick someone up from Bagdogra Airport or NJP station?
faqs.a: Yes. Many drivers do airport and station runs, including late at night. Share the flight or train number so they can track delays.

faqs.q: What documents should I check before hiring a driver?
faqs.a: A valid driving licence for your vehicle type, a photo ID, and references. Keep copies, and check your car insurance covers a hired driver.

seoTitle: Mason & Rajmistri in Siliguri: Building & Repair
seoDescription: Find masons (rajmistri) in Siliguri for house construction, repair, plastering, tiling, flooring and waterproofing. Compare local masons and call directly.
seoHeading: Masons and building repair in Siliguri
imageAlt: Mason laying bricks and mortar on a wall under construction
seoContent:
KaajVa lists masons (rajmistri) and small building contractors in Siliguri for new construction, extensions, repairs, plastering, tile and marble flooring, bathroom and kitchen tiling, boundary walls and waterproofing. Listings show the work they take on and reviews, so you can call a few, ask them to see the site and compare quotes.

Siliguri falls in a high earthquake zone (seismic zone IV), so new construction and extensions need to follow a proper structural design, with columns, beams and reinforcement as per the engineer's drawing. Ask your mason whether they have worked on RCC frame structures and follow drawings, and use the grade of cement, sand and steel specified. For any new floor on an existing building, get a structural engineer's opinion first.

The monsoon decides when to build here. Roof casting, plastering and outside work are best done between October and May. Heavy rain from June to September washes out fresh concrete and plaster and delays curing. Damp walls, roof leaks and cracks around windows are the most common repair jobs after the rains; a mason can find the cause and fix it with crack filling, waterproof plaster or a roof treatment.

Mason work is usually charged by the day (for the mason and helpers) or by the job (per square foot of plaster or tiling). Ask whether material is included, who buys it, and how many people will work each day, and agree on a timeline.

faqs.q: How do I find a good rajmistri in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Masonry on KaajVa, read reviews, and ask the mason to visit the site before quoting. Look at a job they have done recently if you can.

faqs.q: How do masons charge in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Either a daily rate for the mason and helpers, or per square foot for plastering, tiling and flooring. Ask whether materials are included.

faqs.q: When is the best time to build or repair in Siliguri?
faqs.a: October to May. Heavy monsoon rain from June to September disturbs concrete, plaster and curing.

faqs.q: Do I need an engineer for a new floor or extension?
faqs.a: Yes. Siliguri is in seismic zone IV, so any new floor or major change should follow a structural engineer's design and the local building rules.

faqs.q: Can a mason fix roof leaks and damp walls?
faqs.a: Yes. Masons repair cracks, redo plaster with waterproofing compounds and treat roofs. Fix the cause of the damp before painting over it.

seoTitle: Welding & Fabrication Work in Siliguri
seoDescription: Find welders and fabricators in Siliguri for iron gates, grills, railings, shutters, sheds and steel structures. Compare local workshops and call directly.
seoHeading: Welding and fabrication in Siliguri
imageAlt: Welder working on a metal structure with sparks flying
seoContent:
KaajVa lists welders and fabrication workshops across Siliguri, including Matigara, Champasari, Salugara, Bhaktinagar, Burdwan Road and the industrial stretches around the city, for iron and steel gates, window grills, balcony and stair railings, rolling shutters, tin and polycarbonate roof sheds, steel staircases, and repairs to existing metal work.

Most fabrication is priced by weight (per kilogram of steel used) or by the square foot of the finished grill or gate, plus fitting. The section and thickness of the steel decide both the strength and the price, so ask for the size of pipe, box section or flat that will be used, and compare quotes on the same specification. Stainless steel railings cost more but do not rust.

Rust is the main enemy of metal work in Siliguri's humid, rainy climate. Ask the fabricator to clean the steel, apply a red oxide or zinc primer and then two coats of enamel paint, and make sure joints are fully welded and ground so water does not collect. Repainting gates and grills every two or three years, ideally in the dry months, makes them last much longer. Roof sheds should have enough slope and proper gutters for heavy monsoon rain.

For repairs such as a broken gate hinge, a cracked grill or a shutter that will not roll, many welders come to the site with a portable machine. Ask about the visiting charge and whether paint touch-up is included.

faqs.q: How is gate and grill work priced in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Usually by the weight of steel or by the square foot of the finished work, plus fitting. Ask for the steel section and thickness in the quote so you can compare.

faqs.q: How do I stop iron gates and grills rusting?
faqs.a: Make sure the fabricator applies a rust-proof primer and two coats of paint, and repaint every two to three years in the dry season.

faqs.q: Can a welder come to my house for repairs?
faqs.a: Many do, with a portable welding machine for gates, grills and shutters. Ask about the visiting charge.

faqs.q: Do fabricators in Siliguri make roof sheds?
faqs.a: Yes. Many build tin, colour-coated or polycarbonate sheds for roofs, parking and shops. Ask about the slope and gutters for monsoon rain.

faqs.q: Is stainless steel worth it for railings?
faqs.a: For balconies and stairs exposed to rain, yes. It costs more than mild steel but does not rust or need repainting.

seoTitle: Photographers in Siliguri: Wedding & Events
seoDescription: Find photographers and videographers in Siliguri for weddings, pre-wedding shoots, events, portraits and products. Compare portfolios and call directly.
seoHeading: Photographers and videographers in Siliguri
imageAlt: Photographer holding a camera at an event
seoContent:
KaajVa lists photographers and videographers in Siliguri for weddings, pre-wedding shoots, birthdays and rice ceremonies (annaprashan), corporate events, portraits, products for online shops, and drone shots. Listings show their services and, where they have added them, samples of their work, so you can shortlist by style before you call.

Wedding photography is the biggest part of the work here, and the November to February season is fully booked months ahead. Look at a few complete wedding albums, not just highlights, and ask who will actually shoot your event. Packages usually differ in the number of photographers and videographers, the number of days and functions covered, the album size and pages, the edited highlight film, and drone coverage.

The region makes a beautiful backdrop. Pre-wedding and portrait shoots often head to tea gardens around Siliguri, the Mahananda riverside, the Coronation Bridge at Sevoke, the Dooars forests, or up to Darjeeling and Mirik. Ask the photographer about travel charges and permissions for tea estates, and plan around the weather: October to March gives the clearest skies and mountain views, while the monsoon brings lush green but frequent rain.

Agree on everything in writing: dates and hours, the deliverables, the number of edited photos, the delivery time for the album and film, and the advance and cancellation terms. Ask how long they keep the raw files.

faqs.q: How much does a wedding photographer cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of days and functions, the team size, and what is delivered (album, highlight film, drone). Ask for package details in writing and compare them side by side.

faqs.q: When should I book a wedding photographer?
faqs.a: Three to six months ahead for the November to February season, and earlier for popular dates.

faqs.q: Where are good places for a pre-wedding shoot near Siliguri?
faqs.a: Tea gardens around Siliguri, the Mahananda riverside, Sevoke and the Coronation Bridge, the Dooars, and Darjeeling or Mirik. Ask the photographer about travel and permissions.

faqs.q: Do photographers in Siliguri offer drone shots?
faqs.a: Some do. Drone use has rules near the airport and in some areas, so ask the photographer to confirm the location is allowed.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get the wedding album and video?
faqs.a: Usually a few weeks to a few months, depending on the season and the package. Agree on a delivery date before booking.

seoTitle: Yoga Classes & Fitness Trainers in Siliguri
seoDescription: Find yoga teachers, personal trainers, gyms and fitness classes in Siliguri, at home or at a studio. Compare instructors and call directly.
seoHeading: Yoga and fitness trainers in Siliguri
imageAlt: Yoga class practising poses on mats in a studio
seoContent:
KaajVa lists yoga teachers, personal trainers, gyms, Zumba and aerobics classes, and martial arts instructors in Siliguri. Whether you want a morning yoga batch near home, a trainer who comes to your house, or a gym with weight training, you can compare instructors and call them directly.

Start with your goal. For flexibility, back and joint problems, stress or general health, a yoga teacher with formal training (for example a certificate from a recognised yoga institute) is a good start; tell them about any medical conditions, pregnancy or injuries before the first class. For weight loss or strength, a personal trainer can plan workouts and diet together; ask about their certification and whether they have trained people with goals like yours.

Siliguri's hot, humid summers and wet monsoon make outdoor workouts hard for half the year. Early morning batches, indoor studios and home sessions are popular from April to September. Drink more water than you think you need during workouts in the humid months, and take it easy on very hot days.

Most classes are charged monthly, with group batches cheaper than one-on-one sessions and home visits costing more. Ask how many sessions a week are included, the batch size, and whether you can try a class first. Many teachers also offer online sessions, which help in the monsoon.

faqs.q: Where can I find yoga classes in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Search Fitness & Yoga on KaajVa to find yoga teachers and studios near you, including teachers who come home or teach online.

faqs.q: How much does a personal trainer cost in Siliguri?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of sessions a week, home visits or gym sessions, and the trainer's experience. Ask for the monthly fee and what it includes.

faqs.q: Can a yoga teacher come to my home?
faqs.a: Yes. Many yoga teachers on KaajVa offer home sessions for individuals, couples or small family groups.

faqs.q: Is yoga safe if I have back pain or a medical condition?
faqs.a: Often it helps, but tell the teacher about your condition first and check with your doctor. A trained teacher will adapt the poses.

faqs.q: Can I try a class before paying for a month?
faqs.a: Most teachers and gyms offer a trial class. Ask on the call.

seoTitle: Laundry & Dry Cleaning in Siliguri
seoDescription: Find laundry, dry cleaning, ironing and shoe cleaning services in Siliguri, with pickup and delivery. Compare local laundries and call directly.
seoHeading: Laundry and dry cleaning in Siliguri
imageAlt: Folded freshly laundered clothes and towels
seoContent:
KaajVa lists laundries, dry cleaners, ironing (press) services and shoe and bag cleaning in Siliguri. Some work from a shop where you drop clothes off; others pick up and deliver from your home, hostel or office. Listings show services, hours and reviews.

Laundry is usually priced by the kilogram for wash and fold, and by the piece for ironing, dry cleaning and special items such as sarees, suits, blazers, blankets and curtains. Silk sarees, lehengas and woollens need dry cleaning or careful hand washing, so tell the laundry what the fabric is and point out any stains when you hand them over.

Siliguri's monsoon makes laundry a real problem at home. With rain for weeks and humidity close to saturation, clothes take days to dry and often smell musty or get mildew spots. Many families and students send at least their heavy items, such as bedsheets, towels, jeans and blankets, to a laundry with dryers from June to September. Before winter, dry clean or wash woollens, quilts and blankets that have been stored, and store them back in dry, airtight covers to keep fungus and moths away.

Ask the laundry about the turnaround time, pickup and delivery charges, how they handle colour bleeding, and what they do if an item is damaged. Count the clothes when you hand them over and when you get them back.

faqs.q: How much does laundry cost per kg in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Wash and fold is usually priced per kilogram, and ironing and dry cleaning per piece. Prices vary by shop, so ask for their rate list.

faqs.q: Do laundries in Siliguri offer pickup and delivery?
faqs.a: Many do, sometimes free above a minimum order. It is shown on the listing or you can ask on the call.

faqs.q: How do I stop clothes smelling in the monsoon?
faqs.a: Dry them fully, ideally in a dryer, and avoid storing them damp. Sending heavy items to a laundry with dryers during the rains helps a lot.

faqs.q: Can I get sarees and lehengas dry cleaned in Siliguri?
faqs.a: Yes. Dry cleaners handle silk sarees, lehengas, suits and woollens. Point out stains and embellishments when you hand them over.

faqs.q: How long does dry cleaning take?
faqs.a: Usually two to four days, longer before festivals and weddings. Ask for the delivery date when you drop off.
